name: ageno-presentation-slides
description: Skill i skrypty do prezentacji Ageno w jednym pliku HTML (slajdy 16:9, siatka 8 / 32 px).

scripts.check: node -e "for (const f of require('fs').readdirSync('scripts').filter((f) => f.endsWith('.mjs'))) require('child_process').execFileSync(process.execPath, ['--check', 'scripts/' + f], { stdio: 'inherit' })"
scripts.verify: node scripts/grid-audit.mjs assets/template.html && node scripts/text-lint.mjs assets/template.html
